# Dhdt

**Dhdt** is a vloeibaar (continu gepompt) ore. Each extraction yields **450** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/nl/formats/ore-fields/).

## Extractie

| Property | Waarde |
|---|---|
| Aantal / extractie | 450 |
| Extractietype | vloeibaar (continu gepompt) |
| Inschakeleffect | niet vereist |
| Geoscan-document | definition 8706 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
